g.text: ENGLASSIA — CAPITAL WATER AND FOUR APPROACHES
WN-derived setting · exact local placement/shape/construction are our interpretation · no castle building placed
Current · royal lake and dry court
One northern land access and three water crossings. One water polygon avoids artificial internal bank seams.
The 58 registered sites stay fixed; the existing dry academy/guild template stays outside the water.
Two town-to-town road corridors provide the four castle approaches. Exact routing is authored.
Source: author WN56, HTML L21–L23. No LN/anime agreement, initial-state date or complete-capital acceptance claimed.
Terrain/layout study only. The royal castle, wider city, premise registration and runtime placement remain open.
